entry_definition: first visually unambiguous stage attempt held for >=5 actual 10Hz samples; short transition or incomplete visibility is uncertain, not grade0
phase_quality: stage attempt, not correct exercise morphology or severity
boundary_reference: start=Y entry; phase starts=Y/T/W entry; terminal=W entry+4slots; confirmation latency explicitly separate
uncertainty: store entry bracket; if not unambiguous inside +/-0.4s strip expand pixel review; never infer from model output
metrics: compare fixed candidate to video drafts; exact expert ground truth unavailable; uncertainty bracket and scorer/quality support separate
negative_policy: natural contiguous wait/aborted/wrong-order only; no slicing one wait into many, no bad-quality-label copying to incomplete
